rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to say that a container or item has something in it.

example.english: This box can contain three candies.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hap6 jau5 saam1 lap1 tong4

rows.note: Use this for a physical container that holds or is filled with something.

example.english: This bottle can contain hot water.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zeon1 zong1 zyu6 jit6 seoi2

rows.note: Use this when explicitly listing something as a component or included part.

example.english: This set meal will contain a drink and dessert.
example.traditional: 呢份套餐包括飲品同甜品。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 tou3 caan1 baau1 kut3 jam2 ban2 tung4 tim4 ban2

rows.note: Use this when restraining yourself or keeping your emotions or actions under control.

example.english: I was so angry that I wanted to yell at him, but I managed to contain myself.
example.traditional: 我嬲到想鬧人，但係都控制住自己。
example.jyutping: ngo5 nau1 dou3 soeng2 naau6 jan4 daan6 hai6 dou1 hung3 zai3 zyu6 zi6 gei2
